Even in this house of the Mother, there is a silent tyranny, always for your benefit of course, that voice fist, clenched or unclenched, that seeks to show you your way - all attempts at utopia, of matriarchal or patriarchal nature, share this issue - the true u-topia is beyond the politics of gender and the power of engendering which all states seek to manage
